hero.h1: Trenchless Sewer Repair in Geneva, IL
hero.sub: In Geneva's older neighborhoods, the sewer line often runs under a century-old tree, a brick walk or a garden someone has tended for decades. Trenchless repair fixes the pipe through small openings so most of that stays untouched. From our office on Campbell Street.

img.alt: Two J. Blanton plumbers pouring resin into a sewer liner bag to prepare a trenchless pipe lining

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

img.alt: Two J. Blanton plumbers setting up sewer camera and cable equipment beside a home's foundation before a trenchless sewer repair

blocks.h2: Why Trenchless Repair Suits Geneva Properties
blocks.intro: Geneva is a town people take pride in keeping beautiful. Trenchless repair respects that.

items.body: Older Geneva properties often have brick walks, stone walls and trees that took a century to grow. A liner goes in through small openings and leaves them alone.
The trees between the sidewalk and the street are often right over the sewer path. Lining avoids digging through their roots.
Lines patched over the decades with different materials can often be lined end to end, leaving one seamless pipe with no joints.
A collapsed section or deep sag needs a spot dig first. We'll show you on camera if that applies.

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Can a liner go into a very old clay sewer?
items.preview: Often, if the pipe still holds its shape.
items.answer: Often, yes. If the camera shows the pipe is still round and open, it can be lined. Broken or collapsed sections may need a spot repair first.

items.q: Will trenchless repair hurt my old trees?
items.preview: It avoids digging through the root zone.
items.answer: A liner goes inside the existing pipe, so there's no trench through the root zone.

items.q: How long does a liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades, with no joints for roots to get through.

items.q: How long does a trenchless job take?
items.answer: Many residential jobs are done in a day or two.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
